class_definitions.A_audited_op_continuation: gas fingerprint (priority fee, gas limit) identical to an audited operator whose wallets carry it >=50%, amount within op range, and at least one strong rule; or 0.1 h20-21 core of c6 with the 0.1-op fingerprint
class_definitions.B_new_machine_batch: strong rule, nonce 0 at deposit, cluster nonce0-fraction >= 0.7, no audited fingerprint match
class_definitions.C_weak_rule_only: no exact-odd/burst/drip/sequence/peel-chain edge touches the wallet (round-window, split, near-block, hub, gas only)
class_definitions.D_min_deposit_crowd: amount 0.05-0.0505 attached via sequence/burst/drip/hub only (the class the audit itself called provably mixed)
class_definitions.F_strong_rule_aged_or_mixed: remainder: strong rule but aged nonce / mixed

c8_0.45x367_h34-37_vs_amt_0.45_h3.verdict: NOT the same tooling: gas fp 10000000/95250 (349/367) vs op 100000000/91600 (1995/1995); 0 of 367 funders are h3-op members; chain root 0x5cca409dc78ae74f6c0f2538fff392450c95b10e (365 wallets) vs op root 0xf89d7b9c864f589bbf53a82105107622b35eaa40 (1965); nonce0 100%, peel chain 365/367 -> a separate machine batch (class B), not welded to c2 because the 0.45 round-wave windows are >1h apart and 0.45 is round (no exact-odd reach)

detail.why_not_welded: no tier-A edge between c8 and c2: round-wave windows are separated by >1h gap (h4 -> h34); exempt from exact-odd; different blocks

c0_14.3x100_h12-14_vs_amt_14.0_h4.verdict: NOT the same tooling: fp 100000000/95418 (100/100) vs op 10000000/150000 (956/997); 0 funders in the 14.0 op, 99/100 funders inside the 14.3 wave itself; chain root SELF:0x46f81b423e49ef95247e4765e78ad7bf8e04325c vs op root 0xa9ac43f5 (exchange-scale); welded into c0 ONLY by 56 near-same-block edges (14.0 vs 14.3 within 10% in the same block). Machine batch (nonce0 100%, peel chain 100/100) but a different operator or at least different tooling

c6_0.1_h20-21_x100_vs_amt_0.1_h17.verdict: SAME operator: fp None/91600 (100/100 vs 300/321 in op), all 100 chain to the same seed contributor 0xfeb99e2c46b9a5fda836e6d4374a59fc61a5e221 as the 300 audited; contiguous hours (op h17-20, continuation h20-21). Class A.

c6_jitter_h19_x300_vs_idxrun_12058.verdict: SAME operator as the five audited idxrun batches: fp 10000000/90000 identical to idxrun_12058, 6 consecutive-index runs of 50-51 (indices 12327-12376, 12433-12483, 12543-12593, 12652-12702, 12759-12809, 13688-13738 from index_runs.json), all chain to root 0x6688928b01768c92e5f6fafbcf381bee23727395

jitter_50_batches_c55-c87_c159.verdict: SAME operator as idxrun_*: 26 clusters of 50 (h19-20), fps 10000000/90000 (700) and 30000000/87784 (600) = exactly the two idxrun fingerprints, every wallet chains to root 0x6688928b01768c92e5f6fafbcf381bee23727395 (2,135 wallets total under that root: 500 audited + 1,635 new, chains up to 1,999 hops)

fp_35000000_83967_1.2_jitter_x1150_vs_am.verdict: PROBABLY the same operator continuing with jittered amounts: 1,150 non-audited flagged wallets carry the exact 1.2-op fingerprint 35000000/83967 (298/300 of the op; 0 of 613 tx-covered unflagged), amounts 1.17-1.23 ETH, hours 2-5 (op: h1-2), 84 runs of 10 + 14 runs of 20 + 1 of 30 consecutive indices, every wallet has sequence+near-block+gas edges; BUT chain roots differ (op: exchange EOA 0xf70da978 via one 299-hop chain; continuation: 502 under seed contributor 0x56738fbb422ec06c3f38fd9535ddb9c869c1c96b plus 500+ single-hop wallets funded directly from ~500 distinct addresses) and nonce0 only 43% (500 at nonce 0, 156 at nonce 11, 20 at nonce 5). Same tooling is certain; same principal is likely but not proven.

amt_0.45_h3_plus_amt_10.0_h5_plus_amt_17.verdict: ONE operator, not three: 0.45x1995 and 10.0x769 share fingerprint 100000000/91600 (2,764/2,764) and both peel chains end at the same external root 0xf89d7b9c864f589bbf53a82105107622b35eaa40 (1,965 + 769 wallets; chains of up to 1,693 hops); the 171.99x10 ring is funded DIRECTLY by that same address. 2,753 flagged wallets / 17.44% of settled points under one root.

amt_2.067_h13_plus_h18.verdict: ONE operator: both waves share fp 1000000/696769 (324/324) and chain to msgsender.eth 0x00000b7a7a859f1b7ab55579fd4e7b0b22064f3d (320/324); both land in c3 (purity 0.991).

c5_70.0x33.verdict: machine batch: nonce0 97%, peel chain 32/33, single chain of 32 hops seeded from Binance 14; 33 distinct priority fees (jittered gas) -> gas rule cannot see it; welded only by round-wave+split+peel.

hub_0x1ab4973a_staggered_1.x9.verdict: c14/c19/c24/c58/c80 (241 flagged wallets, amounts 1.19/1.29/1.39/1.49/1.59/1.69 ETH, h17-31, nonce0 98%, fps 10000000/91462 or /91600, every wallet funded directly by the exchange-scale EOA 0x1ab4973a, NO strong rule on any wallet): machine-like by nonce/gas/amount stagger but held together only by round-wave + shared-hub edges. Cannot distinguish one operator withdrawing 241 times from 241 customers of one exchange with the same wallet software without on-chain sweep evidence.
